source_of_truth: manual review of every CWE-798 finding against source, recorded in cases/audited_credential_baseline.json

expectations.assertion: Confirmed identifier/message-string false positives produce zero credential findings from the audited locations; every confirmed true positive is still detected; heuristic findings are never published as verified.
expectations.baseline: feature 003 review: identifier-name false positives (SEC-0085 class) published as CWE-798 at 0.95 confidence, verified

expectations.assertion: Runtime-reference assignments ("$VAR", "${VAR}", "%VAR%", "{{ }}", "${{ }}", "$( )", punctuation-joined compositions, ${X:?msg}) produce zero credential findings and are recorded as exempt-reference decisions; reference-look-alike literals (${X:-literal}, ${X:=literal}, ${X:+literal}, $PREFIX-literal, malformed references) are still detected; reproduction text keeps the finding's file path verbatim.
expectations.baseline: feature 010 review: SEC-0080/0082/0084 - env-var references in migration shell scripts published as verified CWE-798 at 0.95 confidence, with the file path redacted out of the reproduction trigger
